method_short: H33-2 B=2.0px Catalogue-Halo-Stripped H27-4/H19-5 Poisson-Disk d=2.8px
exec_summary: Registry leader (0.2778 OWNER-REPORT). Achieved a +0.0070 gain over GEMSDOE28's 0.2708 baseline (h27-4-r1-solo-d2-8, 40,199 dots) via a single surgical geometric operation: expanding the Euclidean exclusion collar around mapped catalogue faults (labels.tif) from B=1.0 px to B=2.0 px (min d_cat = 2.24 px). That stripped exactly 2,545 near-catalogue halo dots (leaving 37,654 binary 1.0 dots, 0 NaNs, -zeros convention) whose 300 m kernels overlapped already-saturated public fault traces and added pure 0.2*FP denominator drag. Also resolved an earlier portal range rejection caused by raw -3.4e38 Float32 sentinels in training_features.tif. Limitation: still inherits the scarp-dominated H19-5 surface (SGMC off-catalogue raw DTI = 0.093694).

method_short: H33-2 Core (37,654 dots) + 1,200 Andersonian Geothermal PINN Extension Dots
exec_summary: Second-highest owner-reported score (0.2750 OWNER-REPORT, 38,854 dots, -nan outside footprint). Retains 100% of GEMSDOE32's 37,654 H33-2 dots (97.40% <=3 px overlap — near-duplicate of GEMSDOE32) and appends 1,200 Andersonian stress / geothermal PINN dots. Because those 1,200 extra dots achieved lower marginal precision than the 0.0556 DTI breakeven threshold at 0.2778, adding them diluted DTI by -0.0028 (0.2778 -> 0.2750). A separate non-H19-5 experiment in GEMSDOE36 (kpl36-exp3, 44,500 dots) scored 0.1647 due to over-concentrating 81% of dots near existing fault tips (only 19.3% far-field >1.5 km).

method_short: H27-4 Ridge-Centered Sub-Selection (40,199 dots) + H36-1 Relay Rungs (41,622 dots)
exec_summary: Breakthrough intermediate stepping-stone (0.2708 on h27-4-r1-solo-d2-8 with 40,199 dots; 0.2710 with +1,423 H36-1 step-over relay rungs = 41,622 dots, 0 NaNs). Improved +0.0108 over GEMSDOE25's 0.2600 d2.8 baseline by re-centering Poisson-disk dots directly onto multi-scale Hessian ridge crests rather than off-axis flank pixels, maximizing the 1 - d/300m triangular kernel height. Still used only a B=1.0 px catalogue buffer, leaving 2,545 redundant halo dots that GEMSDOE32 later removed to reach 0.2778.

method_short: H33d r=3.0px Analog-Tip Stepover Variant (37,068 dots); S33-1 Independent Playas (0.0963)
exec_summary: Contrasts two extremes: its H19-5 thinned variant h33d-r30 (37,068 dots, 92.64% <=3 px overlap with GEMSDOE32) scored 0.2632 (OWNER-REPORT), whereas its independent S33-1 geophysical/radiometric model (37,654 dots) collapsed to 0.0963 because un-vetoed shallow conductivity and uranium anomalies spilled 18.8% of all emitted dots onto flat deep evaporite playas (slope < 2 deg, depth_to_base_surf > 300 m) and packed 14.3% of dots into redundant >=3-neighbor clumps.

method_short: Poisson-Disk d=2.8px Thinning of H19-5 Surface (44,090 dots); H66 Basin Tracker (0.0742)
exec_summary: Demonstrated the non-additive max-cover spacing law: increasing Poisson-disk inter-dot spacing on the H19-5 surface from d=1.5 px (60,069 dots, 0.2477 in GEMSDOE24) to d=2.8 px (44,090 dots) raised live DTI by +0.0123 to 0.2600 by cutting 15,979 redundant neighbor FP dots inside the 300 m kernel radius. Conversely, its independent H66 lineament model scored 0.0742 due to 16.4% flat-playa false-positive spill. Byte-identical d2.8 copies were also mirrored into GEMSDOE30 and GEMSDOE31.

method_short: MSDB1 Multi-Scale Discontinuity Bridge (44,090 dots; also mirrors d2.8 0.2600)
exec_summary: Hosts both a byte-exact mirror of the 0.2600 d2.8 raster (sha256: 91eae1ca...) and a genuinely independent architecture, MSDB1 (44,090 dots, 0.1462 OWNER-REPORT, 39.18% <=3 px overlap with GEMSDOE32). family: H19-5 Early Dense Family (88.5% <=3px w/ GEMSDOE32)
method_short: Dense d=1.5px Dotted H19-5 (60,069 dots, +0.0563 over continuous H19-5 0.1914)
exec_summary: First proof of the discrete dotting jump: converting continuous H19-5 probabilities (0.1914 live) into 60,069 discrete 1.0 dots at d=1.5 px spacing jumped live DTI by +0.0563 to 0.2477 (OWNER-REPORT) because DTI's TP uses max_{d<=300m} p*k(d) while FP sums p across all positive pixels. However, d=1.5 px still packed 2–3 dots inside every 300 m disk (60,069 vs optimal ~38,000). A later GVC1 gravity-volcanic model scored 0.0859 due to un-thinned cluster clumping and deep-basin spill.
